To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we obtain an analytical optimal solution to the problem of hedgin a European option under the mean variance framework with basis risk, 2) we obtain an optimal solution to the dynamic longevity hedge problem with basis risk, which significantly improves upon existing hedging methods and 3) we propose a method to design optimal index insurance contracts under an expected utility framework and obtain analytical solutions for exponential and quadratic utility functions.
we have developed a set of highly tractable and flexible methods to solve a number of important risk management problems in actuarial and financial applications.

we develop a general framework for optimal risk management problems involving basis risk, and we apply this framework to solve several important problems including optimal dynamic hedging of equity-linked derivatives, optimal dynamic hedging for longevity risk and optimal index insurance design.
In summary, our research is concerned with
risk management problems in a variety of settings
the problem of risk management under the presence of basis risks.
risk management problems involving basis risk, and we develop effective methods to quantify and mitigate basis risk in various settings.

this thesis makes significant contributions to the literature of risk management with basis risk by providing analytical solutions for a variety of problems.
our proposed optimal strategies are able to significantly reduce basis risk and achieve the best possible hedging or insurance performance under various settings.
our proposed methods for hedging equity linked derivatives and longevity risk, and designing index insurance are highly tractable and effective in reducing basis risk.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a set of effective and highly implementable tools to quantify and reduce basis risk in a variety of risk management problems.
we develop a set of tractable and effective methods to conduct risk management with basis risk under different settings.

we develop a set of effective methods and analytical solutions for quantifying and managing risk in the presence of significant basis risk, and the proposed methods and solutions are applicable in a variety of important financial and actuarially relevant problems.

basis risk is an important issue in risk management, which needs to be carefully considered and effectively addressed.
